name: Millennial pink

influenced_by: a broad 2010s shift away from earlier decades' brighter, more saturated "girl" pink

garments: a dusty, muted pink across clothing, branding and interiors — Glossier's branding (founded 2014) is a frequently cited example
reacts_against: earlier decades' louder, more gendered hot pink (think Barbiecore), favoring a muted, gender-neutral-marketed, Instagram-friendly dusty rose instead.
